data.content: PLAN_REVIEW PASS with amendments. Direct cursor-agent binary probing is acceptable evidence for this provider-mapping decision because the question is native Cursor confinement, not bridge behavior. The probe should run as the d17e implementation step; any provider mapping change after PROVEN must be a separate follow-up implementation slice. Required probe additions before execution: include an absolute repo/project-root write target in addition to TMPDIR/HOME/root; include a hardlink-inside-to-outside vector where the platform allows creating it, with unsupported recorded as skipped not passed; include an explicit --add-dir interaction control so any expansion of writable scope is documented and the future mapping does not emit --add-dir unless separately proven safe. Decision gate otherwise approved: M1 must allow inside workspace writes and deny every outside vector for both native Write and shell; M2 must demonstrate escape or the harness is inconclusive; any hang/non-escape/escape in the wrong cell means NOT PROVEN and shipped fail-closed mapping stays.
